newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma Inc sets terms on rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma Inc sets terms on rights offer.

text.p: Alpharma Inc said on Monday that its directors will issue a dividend, to take the form of certain subscription rights, to shareholders of its class A common stock of record on August 26, 1997.
Under the plan, each record holder will receive one right for every six shares of class A stock held on the record date, the company said in a statement.
In turn, each right will entitle its holder to buy one share of class A stock at a subscription price of $16.34 per share, the pharmaceutical company said.
